summary: Apogee Enterprises filed an 8-K confirming completion of its acquisition of SIA Alzette, a Latvian limited liability company whose subsidiaries include GroGlass, a glass coatings producer. Under the September 2, 2026 Share Purchase Agreement, Apogee's wholly-owned subsidiary Tiger MergeCo SIA acquired 100% of SIA Alzette's equity for roughly €62.5 million cash-free, debt-free, subject to customary adjustments, plus up to €10 million of contingent earnout consideration payable over three years tied to specified financial performance targets. Apogee funded the deal with cash and revolver borrowings. The transaction was announced September 3, 2026; no board recommendation or advisor was disclosed.
